- Quantifies temporal accuracy of OSM cycling-change detection.
- Reproducible snapshot differencing with stratified Street View audit.
- Additions detected reliably (precision 0.82; recall 0.96).
- Apparent removals often reflect mapping edits, not real loss.
- Provides calibration framework for OSM-based longitudinal studies.
